Create a cinematic 30-second photorealistic sci-fi short film set in a futuristic architectural complex at golden hour. The location features enormous white futuristic structures, curved glass buildings, elevated walkways, reflective pools, and a clean high-tech plaza.

SHOT 1 — 0-4s:
A massive black off-road monster truck with oversized mud-covered tires slowly drives through the futuristic plaza. The truck has rugged armored body panels, a lifted suspension, glowing blue LED headlights, and a cinematic sci-fi design. Wide establishing shot, low camera angle, realistic reflections, warm sunset lighting, subtle dust and tire movement.

SHOT 2 — 4-8s:
Cut to a closer tracking shot of the monster truck. A young girl is visible sitting inside the driver's seat. She has long brown hair and wears a purple coat/dress. The truck is heavily modified and covered with realistic dirt and mud. Camera moves smoothly alongside the vehicle, cinematic depth of field.

SHOT 3 — 8-12s:
The girl steps out of the monster truck and stands beside it. She looks toward the futuristic plaza with a calm but curious expression. In the background, futuristic humanoid robots can be seen walking around. Keep the girl's appearance, purple outfit, hairstyle and proportions consistent.

SHOT 4 — 12-16s:
A gigantic heavily armored humanoid robot appears in the center of the futuristic plaza. It is enormous, mechanical and industrial, with dark metallic armor, glowing blue energy elements and powerful robotic legs. The girl stands nearby looking up at it. Dramatic low-angle camera movement emphasizes the robot's enormous scale.

SHOT 5 — 16-20s:
Reveal a futuristic robotic workshop in the plaza. Multiple giant robots are being repaired and assembled around workstations, surrounded by tools, mechanical parts, cables and industrial equipment. The girl walks through the workshop while observing the machines. Wide cinematic shot with realistic mechanical details.

SHOT 6 — 20-24s:
Close-up of the girl reacting with amazement while looking at a giant robot being repaired beside her. Her facial expression shows wonder and excitement. Detailed realistic face, natural hair movement, soft golden light, shallow depth of field. Large robotic machinery fills the background.

SHOT 7 — 24-28s:
The girl stands in front of a huge futuristic robot as blue-purple energy begins glowing around the machine. The environment becomes more dramatic and cinematic. The robot's lights intensify while mechanical components activate. Camera slowly pushes toward the girl and robot.

SHOT 8 — 28-30s:
The girl suddenly rises into the air using futuristic purple-blue energy propulsion beneath her feet. She floats high above the futuristic building while the giant robot watches from below. Her purple coat flows naturally in the wind. Wide heroic final shot looking upward toward the bright blue sky and futuristic architecture.

STYLE:
Photorealistic cinematic sci-fi film, ultra-detailed environments, realistic human skin and hair, realistic mechanical surfaces, physically accurate lighting, volumetric sunlight, cinematic depth of field, subtle film grain, high-end Hollywood production design, anamorphic lens look, smooth professional camera movement, realistic shadows and reflections, coherent character appearance throughout, seamless transitions, dramatic but family-friendly adventure tone.

IMPORTANT:
Maintain the same girl, clothing, hairstyle, monster truck and robot designs throughout the entire video. Natural human motion, realistic physics, consistent proportions, no distorted faces, no extra limbs, no flickering objects, no random character changes, no text, no subtitles, no watermark.
extra-8fbf1d01dc8e:
Made with seedance 2.5
Using @openart_ai

Prompt 

Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home-video showing a young Korean woman visiting a traditional countryside farm and learning how to milk a cow. No reference image.

MAIN SUBJECT:
A naturally pretty Korean woman in her early 20s, realistic skin texture, minimal makeup, long black hair tied in a loose low ponytail. She wears a simple pale-yellow cotton T-shirt, relaxed blue jeans, white sneakers, and a small beige crossbody bag. Keep the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and appearance throughout.

SETTING:
A small traditional Korean countryside farm on a warm summer afternoon. Old wooden barn, cows, hay, buckets, farming tools, green fields and simple farmhouse surroundings. Everything should feel authentic, ordinary and lived-in.

CAMERA:
The camera is ALWAYS IN FRONT OF THE GIRL, never behind her. A friend films her while standing or walking backward in front of her using a handheld smartphone/early-2000s consumer DV camcorder. Her face stays clearly visible. Strong natural handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure changes, slight motion blur, soft digital detail and mild image noise.

NO cinematic camera movements, NO gimbal, NO drone, NO rear shots, NO polished commercial look, NO beauty filter.

TIMELINE

0:00–0:05 — Entering the Barn
The girl walks toward the camera with her friend filming from directly in front. She looks excitedly at the cows and smiles. She says in Korean:
“오늘 소 젖 짜는 걸 배워볼 거예요.”

0:05–0:10 — Getting Ready
Hard cut. She sits beside a calm cow while an experienced farmer demonstrates how to position the bucket and gently milk. The camera stays in front, showing her face and hands naturally.

0:10–0:15 — Awkward First Attempt
She tries milking herself. At first she squeezes incorrectly and barely gets any milk into the bucket. She looks confused, then laughs at herself.
“어? 왜 안 나오지?”

0:15–0:21 — Trying Again
Hard cut. The farmer calmly shows her the correct hand movement. She tries again while the friend films from the front. This time milk starts flowing into the bucket. Her face immediately lights up.

0:21–0:26 — She Gets It
She continues successfully, looking proudly toward the camera. She laughs and says:
“됐다! 진짜 된다!”

0:26–0:30 — Happy Ending
She stands beside the cow holding the small bucket and smiles at the camera. She gently pats the cow and gives a little wave.
“오늘 진짜 재밌었어요. 안녕!”
Natural cut to black.

AUDIO:
Only real farm sounds: cow mooing, bucket sounds, footsteps, birds, insects, distant farm activity and natural conversation. No music and no narration.

OVERALL STYLE:
It must look like a genuine friend-recorded memory from an ordinary farm visit—not a movie or advertisement. Front-facing coverage throughout, with natural reactions and imperfect handheld footage.

时长29秒，比例16:9横屏，语言中文。
人物参考：仅参考图片1锁定五官、发型、肤色和人物身份；服装严格按下文变化。人物要求：成年女主。全程同一人物，不换脸、不改变身材比例；提高权重，优先死死锁住五官、发型、肤色、身份。

整体风格：超真实AI动态桌面互动视频，模拟电脑全屏桌面录屏。底部保留简洁任务栏，左上角少量桌面图标；画面主体是一张会实时互动的动态壁纸。黑色皮质沙发，冷色柔光，深色背景。固定机位，全程一镜连续，不切镜、不推拉。女主主要位于画面右侧，左侧留给语音字幕界面。

字幕界面（保留，覆盖「禁止文字」约束）：字幕必须出现于画面左侧中部，不能放在底部。纤细现代无衬线中文字体，中等字号，无底框，轻微柔光和阴影。女主说话：淡紫色文字，左侧显示扬声器图标。男声说话：白色文字，左侧显示麦克风图标。字幕下方始终有一条细小白色音频波形，随声音实时跳动。所有字幕跟随发音逐字输入，约每字0.08—0.12秒，像键盘正在手动打字；当前句说完后停留约0.4秒，再整体淡出。不能整句突然出现，不能提前显示后面的字。

服装设计（三套造型统一只改领口：低圆领/浅V领，微露事业线，其余保持完整遮盖）：
初始造型：黑白横条纹修身短款七分袖上衣（低圆领/浅V领，微露事业线，其余完整遮盖），黑色低腰抽绳休闲长裤，银色细项链。
第一套学院风：上衣为低圆领/浅V领、微露事业线、其余完整遮盖，蓝黑格纹百褶短裙，白色过膝袜，白色十字装饰袜带，整体清爽俏皮。
第二套学院风：黑色修身西装外套、白色衬衫（衬衫低圆领/浅V领，微露事业线，其余完整遮盖）、酒红格纹领带、酒红黑色格纹百褶短裙、浅肤色薄丝袜、黑色乐福鞋，精致成熟。

SINGLE CONTINUOUS SHOT（00:00-00:29）

00:00-00:02.80
女主穿初始造型坐在黑色皮沙发右侧，腿上抱着黑色靠枕。她双手轻轻整理头发，随后看向镜头，露出亲切、略带俏皮的微笑。
女主自然开口：「说吧……今天想看什么？」
字幕逐字显示：「说吧……
今天想看什么？」

男主始终不露脸，仅有画外男声，语气直接而期待：「想看JK。」
女主安静听着，笑容稍微加深，轻轻点头。
字幕逐字显示：「想看JK」

00:04.70-00:06.00
女主爽快回答：「好，等我一下。」
她把怀里的靠枕放到一旁，右手撑住沙发准备起身。

00:06.00-00:08.80
女主快速起身。由于机位固定且距离较近，她的腰部和腿部从镜头前向上掠过，脸部离开画面上沿；随后向右侧走出画面。动作带轻快的「嗖」声，但不能瞬移、不能直接变形。

00:08.80-00:11.50

女主带着展示新造型的俏皮语气说：「当当……老公……怎么样？」

老公……怎么样？」

男主画外音稍作思考，满意地回答：「嗯……不错。」

女主突然想起另一套造型，轻快地说：「等等，还有一套。」

00:17.40-00:19.00
女主停在镜头右侧，略微调整站姿，让西装下摆和裙褶自然落下，询问：「这套呢？」

00:19.50-00:20.50
男主画外音立即赞赏：「这套也好看。」
女主听完轻轻笑一下，身体开始降低准备坐下。

00:20.50-00:24.80
伴随轻微衣料摩擦声，女主迅速而自然地坐回沙发。她将黑色靠枕重新放在腿上，整理两侧头发和领带，随后微微侧身靠住沙发。镜头重新完整拍到她的脸。她始终看着镜头，表情自信、亲近、略带捉弄感。

00:25.00-00:28.20
女主抱住靠枕，先露出得意的小笑容，然后对镜头说：「机会用完啦。老公想留哪套呢？」
「机会用完啦」语气像宣布游戏规则；「老公想留哪套呢」稍微放慢，尾音上扬，带亲密询问感。
字幕逐字显示：「机会用完啦。

字幕完整停留。女主保持眼神交流，轻轻偏头，嘴角维持俏皮微笑。波形逐渐归于平静，画面自然结束。

音频：女主真实现场人声，口型精确；男主为镜头外中文男声，不露脸。保留轻微电子氛围音乐（对白时自动降低，权重提高）、换装「嗖」声、亮相提示音、衣料摩擦声，所有对白清楚可辨。

表演约束：女主不是夸张卖萌。微笑、点头、整理头发、展示服装均自然克制；开场亲切，第一次换装俏皮，第二次换装更自信，结尾带轻微捉弄感。男声说话时女主必须闭嘴并自然聆听。
